briefdescription.para: Phase 2/3 hardening focused tests for the maintenance module.

detaileddescription.para:
Covers:
Phase 2: schedule-entry serialization round-trips, frequency/cron mapping, task-type string dispatch, job-state string dispatch, default field constraints.
Phase 3: fail-safe field defaults, DAG dependency serialization round-trips, halt-on-failure flag persistence.
No file I/O, no network, no real orchestrator instantiation — deterministic only.
